instruction: Export the Personal Address Book from Thunderbird to CSV on the Desktop. Count how many contacts were born in the 1990s (1990-1999 inclusive) and save this count to '1990s_count.txt' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires two verifications: (1) Export Personal Address Book to CSV on Desktop, and (2) Count contacts born in 1990-1999 and save to file. The evaluator checks both: CSV file existence on Desktop and count file content matching expected value '8'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if both requirements met (CSV exists on Desktop AND count file contains '8'), 0.0 otherwise

calculation_details.verification_method: Analyzed Thunderbird Personal Address Book contacts from contacts_gold.csv, counting all contacts with Birth Year field between 1990-1999 inclusive

llm_judge_reasons: PASS: Evaluator correctly checks both instruction requirements: CSV export exists on Desktop AND count file contains correct value
Expected value '8' is properly verified: metadata.calculation_details lists all 8 contacts born in 1990-1999 with names and birth years

Getter logic is correct: Reads count file content and checks CSV existence on Desktop with preference for address-book-related filenames
Metric logic is correct: Compares count value (string match with strip) and verifies CSV existence, returns 1.0 only if both met

Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified
